classification: New bounded reanalysis of an already inspected sibling capture; not an independent holdout or a hardware-parameter fit.
scope: Table 0 (SIN), source-observability and half-wave antisymmetry only; no production DSP change, no audio generation, no new download, no additional noise.
frequency_rule: Use unchanged table-0 f0 from retained analysis (523.0663737370845 Hz); no new frequency search or phase alignment.
subdivision_rule: One full window and its seven contiguous 50 ms interiors, without inspection-dependent rejection.

capture_fits.base: Hann-weighted least squares, DC and sine/cosine coefficients for harmonics 1..12; fixed f0; local time centered at midpoint.
capture_fits.nuisance_basis: For order 1/2, add t*sin(f0*t), t*cos(f0*t), and then t^2*sin(f0*t), t^2*cos(f0*t). These are diagnostics for slowly changing carrier amplitude/phase, not hardware law estimates.
reported: H2 phase minus twice fundamental phase
unweighted residual RMS relative to capture RMS
weighted residual RMS relative to weighted capture RMS
capture_fits.excluded: No EQ, per-harmonic correction, input/capture nonlinearity fit, gain calibration, sample-rate estimate, bit-depth or physical parameter adoption. Every predeclared fit is retained.

synthetic_probe.definition: Uniform phase addresses; midpoint sampled sine, second half made exactly the negative of first; symmetric round-to-nearest signed amplitude levels. Check y(theta+pi)=-y(theta), DC and even harmonics. These widths are a separating synthetic sweep only, never proposed OPU specifications.
synthetic_probe.positive_control: Add a known quadratic term to ideal sine to demonstrate the harmonic estimator detects broken half-wave antisymmetry; alpha=0.04 is an arbitrary test-fixture constant, not a proposed hardware distortion.
synthetic_probe.no_claim: The probe does not enumerate asymmetric ROMs, phase-dependent special bit logic, dynamic clock/update aliases, nonstationary modulation, DACs, speakers, microphones or codecs. It cannot identify the target's arithmetic width.

acceptance: All source hashes must match; every declared fit/candidate must be emitted. Synthetic half-wave equality must hold exactly, all even harmonic magnitudes/DC below 1e-12 relative to fundamental, and the quadratic positive control H2/H1 must equal alpha/2 within 1e-12 absolute. No promotion gate or product change is implied.
chronology: This document was written before executing the new capture fits or synthetic sweep. The old full-window harmonic result was known before design; no claim of pristine holdout.
